title.narrative: CSR-facility. Tomorrow's partnership models for strategic CSR - A cross-sectorial project in both Denmark and developing countries

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to gather and distribute knowledge about strategic Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). To develop and test a sustainable framework and model for tomorrow¿s strategic CSR partnerships between businesses and civil society organisations. The project will be executed in two tracks: The purpose of the first track is to gather knowledge on existing CSR partnerships, validate and develop new methods and tools in dialogue with 10-15 Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) and businesses in Denmark in a so called partnership arena. The purpose of the second track is to test pilot-partnership cases with selected CSOs and their preferred business partners, achieving both validation of the developed models, and developmental impact in the respective local communities in which the pilot projects are conducted. The project is conducted in broad collaboration with Danish businesses and CSOs. The 2-year project was granted in December 2013.
